source: I don't trust someone who changes their story every time.
target: One whose story shifts with every telling shall never earn my trust.

source: If you want my help, tell me the whole truth.
target: If it is my help you seek, then lay the whole truth before me.

source: You promised you would be here, and you weren't.
target: You gave your word that you would be here… and yet your place stood empty.

source: I need time to think before I make this decision.
target: Before this decision is made, I must have time to weigh it in thought.

source: Don't mistake my silence for agreement.
target: Do not take my silence for consent. My silence agrees to nothing.

source: We can disagree without turning this into a fight.
target: We may stand divided in our views without letting this descend into battle.

source: I made a mistake, and I will take responsibility for it.
target: The mistake was mine. I shall carry the full weight of its responsibility.

source: I won't abandon someone just because things got difficult.
target: I shall not abandon anyone merely because the road has grown hard.

source: The evidence doesn't support what you're claiming.
target: Your claims stand alone. The evidence offers them no support.

source: Let's hear everyone before we choose a direction.
target: Let every voice be heard in full before we choose the path we shall walk.

source: I can forgive you, but rebuilding trust will take time.
target: Forgiveness I can grant you. But trust, once broken, will take time to rebuild.

source: Don't make a promise unless you intend to keep it.
target: Speak no promise unless you intend to honor it to the end.

source: I understand why you're angry, but threatening people won't solve it.
target: Your anger has its reasons, and I understand them. But threats against others will resolve nothing.

source: We have one chance to get this right, so prepare carefully.
target: One chance is all we are granted to get this right. Prepare with the utmost care.

source: I would rather hear an uncomfortable truth than a comforting lie.
target: I would sooner endure a truth that unsettles me than accept a lie that comforts.

source: You don't have to solve everything today.
target: Not every burden must be resolved this day.

source: If the plan fails, we need a backup ready.
target: Should the plan fail, a second path must already stand ready.

source: I won't let fear make this decision for me.
target: Fear shall not choose for me. This decision belongs to me alone.

source: The team needs a clear answer, not another delay.
target: The team demands a clear answer. Another delay will not serve them.

source: I need you to listen, not just wait for your turn to speak.
target: Hear my words truly. Do not merely wait for the moment you may speak.

source: I won't sign anything I haven't read carefully.
target: Nothing shall bear my signature until I have read it with care.

source: Your past doesn't have to decide your future.
target: Your past need not dictate what your future holds.

source: We should check the facts before blaming anyone.
target: Before any blame is cast, let us first examine the facts.

source: I can work with a difficult person if they are honest.
target: Even a difficult soul I can labor beside… so long as honesty guides them.

source: I need a clear boundary, and I need you to respect it.
target: A clear boundary must be drawn. And you must honor it.

source: We should not confuse confidence with certainty.
target: We should not let the strength of our confidence pose as certainty.

source: If you need to change the plan, tell me early.
target: If the plan must change, bring word to me early, while there is still time.

source: I don't want praise; I want the problem fixed.
target: I seek no praise. I seek only that the problem be mended.

source: We need to protect the people who depend on us.
target: Those who depend upon us must be shielded. That duty falls to us.

source: A quick answer is useless if it sends us in the wrong direction.
target: A swift answer holds no worth if it leads us down the wrong path.

source: I need proof that this will work before I approve it.
target: Show me proof that this will succeed. Only then shall I grant my approval.

source: Don't punish the whole team for one person's mistake.
target: Do not let the error of one bring punishment upon the whole team.

source: I am willing to start again, but not pretend nothing happened.
target: I am willing to begin anew. But I will not pretend that nothing came to pass.

source: You can ask for help without giving up control.
target: You may seek aid without surrendering your command.

source: I won't let one bad day define the entire project.
target: A single bad day shall not define the whole of this project. I will not allow it.

source: If we hide the risk, we cannot manage it.
target: If the risk is hidden from us, we lose all power to manage it.

source: I respect your experience, but we still need to test the idea.
target: Your experience has my respect. Yet the idea must still face its trial.

source: I need a decision today, even if the answer is no.
target: A decision must reach me before this day ends… even if that answer is no.

source: I know the task is difficult, but we can break it into smaller steps.
target: The task is formidable; this I know. Yet it can be broken into smaller steps.

source: I need you to tell me when you are unsure instead of guessing.
target: When certainty eludes you, tell me so. Do not offer guesses in its place.

source: I never said I would pay for it.
target: Never did I say that the cost would be mine to bear.

source: Call me once the report is ready, not before.
target: Summon me once the report stands complete. Not before.

source: The meeting moved from Tuesday to Thursday at 4 pm.
target: The meeting has abandoned Tuesday. It now awaits us on Thursday, at four in the afternoon.

source: Tell Ravi the keys are with Meera.
target: Carry word to Ravi: the keys now rest in Meera's keeping.

source: Did anyone check the second invoice?
target: Has any among you examined the second invoice?

source: Please send me the photos tonight.
target: Send me the photographs before this night ends.

source: I am sorry I missed your call; I was on the train.
target: Forgive me. Your call went unanswered while the train carried me onward.

source: We can leave after Neha finishes her appointment.
target: When Neha's appointment has reached its end, we may take our leave.

source: Don't send the package until I confirm the address.
target: The package must wait. Send nothing until the address has my confirmation.

source: The shop closes at 8, so we need to leave by 7:30.
target: The shop shuts its doors at eight. By half past seven, we must be on our way.

source: I ordered two blue shirts, not three black ones.
target: My order was for two blue shirts. Three black ones were never requested.

source: Unless the rain stops, the match will start late.
target: Unless the rain relents, the match shall be forced to begin late.

source: I have already paid the electricity bill for October.
target: October's electricity bill has already been settled by my hand.

source: Please don't wake Dad before 6 am.
target: Let Father sleep, I ask you, until six in the morning.

source: I can pick up Asha at 5:15 if the bus is on time.
target: At a quarter past five, I can collect Asha… if the bus keeps to its hour.

source: The phone is cheaper online, but delivery takes four days.
target: Online, the phone demands a lesser price. Yet its delivery shall take four days.

source: I will not share your number without asking you first.
target: Your number shall pass to no one unless I have first sought your consent.

source: Maya left her umbrella at the school gate.
target: Maya's umbrella was left behind, abandoned at the school gate.

source: We missed the earlier bus because the driver left five minutes early.
target: The earlier bus slipped from our grasp. Its driver departed five minutes before his time.

source: I can lend you 500 rupees, but I need it back by Friday.
target: Five hundred rupees I can lend you. But by Friday, it must return to my hands.

source: If you have not booked the tickets, don't pay the seller yet.
target: If the tickets remain unbooked, withhold payment from the seller for now.

source: I prefer tea without sugar, even when it is cold.
target: Tea without sugar is my chosen way, even when its warmth has faded.

source: We should buy only what is on the list.
target: We should claim only what the list demands, and nothing beyond it.

source: The clinic is closed on Sundays, so book for Monday.
target: On Sundays the clinic's doors stay shut. Secure an appointment for Monday.

source: I took the wrong exit and reached the old bridge.
target: I took the wrong exit… and found myself before the old bridge.

source: Don't delete the message until I take a screenshot.
target: Let the message remain untouched until I have captured a screenshot of it.

source: I will bring the rice if you make the vegetables.
target: The rice I shall provide, if the vegetables are prepared by your hand.

source: The parcel arrived today, but one glass is broken.
target: The parcel reached us this day. Yet within it, one glass lies broken.

source: I have two exams next week, on Wednesday and Friday.
target: Next week, two exams await me: one on Wednesday, one on Friday.

source: Please keep the receipt in case we need to return the shoes.
target: Preserve the receipt, if you would. The shoes may yet need to be returned.

source: I didn't cancel the booking; the hotel changed it.
target: The booking was not cancelled by me. It was the hotel that altered it.

source: If the medicine makes you dizzy, call the doctor before taking another dose.
target: Should the medicine bring dizziness upon you, call the doctor before you take another dose.

source: I can meet at the station at 6:40, but I cannot wait past 7.
target: At twenty to seven, I can meet you at the station. Beyond seven, I cannot wait.

source: We need three copies, one for each department.
target: Three copies are required of us, one to be given to each department.

source: I am grateful you checked on Grandma yesterday.
target: You looked in on Grandmother yesterday. For that, my gratitude is yours.

source: Don't tell Arjun the surprise plan before Saturday.
target: The surprise plan must stay hidden from Arjun until Saturday arrives.

source: The internet stopped working after the power cut.
target: The power was cut… and since then, the internet has fallen silent.

source: I can stay for 20 minutes, not the whole evening.
target: Twenty minutes I can give you. The whole evening, I cannot.

source: Please charge the power bank before we leave at 9.
target: Restore the power bank's strength, if you would, before we depart at nine.

source: I have not received the refund, although the app says it was processed.
target: The app proclaims the refund processed. Yet it has not reached me.

source: We should leave the spare key with Kavita, not under the mat.
target: We should entrust the spare key to Kavita, not hide it beneath the mat.

source: The train was delayed by 35 minutes because of fog.
target: The fog descended and delayed the train by thirty-five minutes.

source: I will send the file after I remove the customer details.
target: The customer details must first be stripped away. Only then shall I send the file.

source: If Tara calls while I am driving, please text her that I will call later.
target: Should Tara call while I am driving, send her a message, if you would: I shall call later.

source: I need the smaller bag because the larger one will not fit under the seat.
target: The smaller bag is what I require. The larger one will not fit beneath the seat.

source: We have enough milk for breakfast, but not enough for the cake.
target: Our milk will suffice for breakfast… but for the cake, there is not enough.

source: I forgot to lock the back door, so please check it now.
target: The back door was left unlocked through my neglect. Go and check it now, I ask you.

source: The school bus comes at 7:10, not 7:30.
target: The school bus arrives at ten past seven. Half past seven is not its hour.

source: I will join the call, unless my appointment runs late.
target: I shall join the call, unless my appointment holds me past its hour.

source: No one has replied to the message I sent on Monday.
target: The message I sent on Monday has met only silence. Not one reply has come.

source: Please put the frozen peas in the freezer, not the fridge.
target: Place the frozen peas within the freezer, if you would. The fridge is not their place.

source: I can exchange the shirt only if the tag is still attached.
target: The shirt may be exchanged, but only while its tag remains attached.

source: We arrived early, but the museum had not opened yet.
target: We arrived ahead of time… yet the museum's doors had not yet opened.

source: I can help you move on Sunday if you book the van.
target: If you book the van, I can lend my strength to your move on Sunday.

source: The bill includes delivery, so do not pay an extra fee.
target: The bill already accounts for delivery. Do not pay a single extra fee.

source: I'll take the library book back tomorrow morning.
target: When morning comes tomorrow, I shall return the library book to its rightful home.

source: Don't mix the two orders; one is for Nikhil and one is for Rupa.
target: Keep the two orders apart. One is meant for Nikhil, the other for Rupa.

source: The recipe needs 250 grams of flour, not 500.
target: Two hundred and fifty grams of flour is what the recipe demands. Not five hundred.

source: I won't approve the expense until I see the original receipt.
target: The expense shall not receive my approval until the original receipt is laid before me.

source: If the lift is still broken, use the stairs to the third floor.
target: If the lift still lies broken, climb the stairs to the third floor.

source: Can you send me the slides before the meeting starts?
target: Before the meeting commences, will you deliver the slides into my hands?

source: I haven't finished the budget report yet, but I will by Thursday.
target: The budget report is not yet complete. But by Thursday, I shall see it finished.

source: Please don't schedule anything for me on Friday afternoon.
target: Keep my Friday afternoon free of all appointments, I ask you.

source: Ravi is leading the client call today instead of Meera.
target: Today it is Ravi, not Meera, who shall lead the client call.

source: If the server goes down again, call the support team immediately.
target: If the server falls again, summon the support team without delay.

source: Sorry, I sent the wrong version of the contract this morning.
target: Forgive me. This morning, the wrong version of the contract left my hands.

source: Thank you for covering my shift last week.
target: You bore my shift last week. For that, you have my gratitude.

source: The new hire starts on Monday at 9 am, not Tuesday.
target: The new hire shall take up their post on Monday at nine in the morning… not on Tuesday.

source: We can't approve the leave request until the manager signs it.
target: Until the manager's signature rests upon it, the leave request cannot be approved.

source: Who is taking notes in today's meeting?
target: Who shall bear the duty of taking notes in today's meeting?

source: I will finish the presentation tonight, even if it takes until midnight.
target: Tonight the presentation shall be finished, even if the labor stretches until midnight.

source: The printer on the third floor is out of toner and won't print.
target: The printer on the third floor has spent the last of its toner. It refuses to print.

source: Sofia asked for two more days because she hasn't finished reviewing the proposal.
target: Sofia seeks two more days. Her review of the proposal is not yet complete.

source: Let's move the standup to 10:30 so everyone can attend.
target: Let us move the standup to half past ten, so that all may gather for it.

source: The meeting ran long, but we agreed on the next steps.
target: The meeting stretched beyond its hour, yet we emerged agreed upon the next steps.

source: Don't reply to the client until legal has checked the email.
target: Do not answer the client until legal has passed its eye over the email.

source: Daniel didn't get the invitation for the training session.
target: The invitation to the training session never found its way to Daniel.

source: Could you check whether the invoice was paid?
target: Will you learn, if you would, whether the invoice has been settled?

source: We need at least five people to run the workshop.
target: No fewer than five people are required to bring the workshop to life.

source: I'm not sure the deadline is realistic.
target: I am not certain this deadline lies within our reach.

source: Please add Aisha to the project channel.
target: Grant Aisha a place in the project channel, if you would.

source: The office will be closed on the 15th for maintenance.
target: On the fifteenth, the office shall close its doors for maintenance.

source: I will review your code after lunch.
target: I shall examine your code once lunch is behind me.

source: Unless the client objects, we'll ship the update on Wednesday.
target: Unless the client raises an objection, the update shall go out on Wednesday.

source: Tom wants the summary in one page, not five.
target: Tom seeks a summary of one page. Five pages he does not want.

source: I apologise for interrupting you during the presentation.
target: I broke into your words during the presentation. For that, I apologise.

source: The quarterly targets were missed by a small margin.
target: The quarterly targets were missed… by a small margin, but missed all the same.

source: Can we postpone the review to next week?
target: Can we set the review aside until next week?

source: The team prefers short meetings rather than long email threads.
target: The team favors brief meetings over long threads of email.

source: I won't be able to join the dinner after the conference.
target: When the conference ends, the dinner shall proceed without me. I cannot join it.

source: Priya has already booked the conference room for 2 pm.
target: Priya has already secured the conference room for the hour of two in the afternoon.

source: If you finish early, help Leo with the testing.
target: Should you finish early, lend Leo your strength in the testing.

source: The draft is good, but the conclusion needs more evidence.
target: The draft is good. Yet its conclusion needs more evidence to stand upon.

source: Nobody told me the launch was cancelled.
target: The launch was cancelled, and no one thought to tell me.

source: Please submit your timesheets by 5 pm on Friday.
target: Your timesheets must be submitted by five on Friday evening, if you would.

source: We hired three engineers this quarter, not four.
target: Three engineers joined our ranks this quarter. Not four.

source: Thanks for explaining the new process so clearly.
target: You laid out the new process with great clarity. My thanks to you.

source: I'll send the minutes once everyone has reviewed them.
target: Once every eye has reviewed the minutes, I shall send them forth.

source: Why was the release delayed again?
target: Why has the release been held back yet again?

source: The client liked the design but wants a darker colour.
target: The design found favor with the client, yet they desire a darker colour.

source: Don't share the salary figures with anyone outside HR.
target: The salary figures must not pass beyond HR. Share them with no one outside it.

source: Meera will cover for me while I'm on leave.
target: While I am away on leave, Meera shall stand in my place.

source: The laptop allowance is 60,000 rupees per employee.
target: Each employee is granted sixty thousand rupees for a laptop.

source: We should test it on a small group before rolling it out.
target: Let it first be tested on a small group before it is unleashed upon all.

source: I didn't mean to sound rude in that email.
target: That email was not meant to wound. Rudeness was never my intent.

source: If the numbers don't match, flag it to finance.
target: Should the numbers fail to match, bring the matter before finance.

source: I'll be working from home on Tuesday and Wednesday.
target: On Tuesday and Wednesday, my labors shall be carried out from home.

source: Could you introduce me to the new marketing lead?
target: Will you present me to the new marketing lead?

source: Although the project is behind schedule, the quality is excellent.
target: The project lags behind its schedule… yet its quality is excellent.

source: I promise to have the figures ready before the board meeting.
target: You have my word: the figures shall stand ready before the board convenes.

source: The interview is at 11 am, so I'll be offline for an hour.
target: The interview is at eleven in the morning. For one hour, I shall be beyond reach.

source: Please don't forward this message to the whole department.
target: This message is not meant for the whole department. Do not forward it to them, I ask you.

source: I'm sorry the report was late; the data arrived only yesterday.
target: Forgive the lateness of the report. The data reached me only yesterday.

source: Aisha thinks we need a bigger budget, but I disagree.
target: Aisha believes a bigger budget is required. In this, I do not stand with her.

source: Is the training mandatory for contractors too?
target: Are contractors too bound to undergo the training?

source: We will hire a designer if the funding is approved.
target: If the funding is approved, we shall bring a designer into our ranks.

source: The CEO is visiting our branch next Thursday.
target: Next Thursday, our branch shall receive the CEO.

source: I can't access the shared drive from my new laptop.
target: My new laptop cannot reach the shared drive. It remains closed to me.

source: Let's not decide anything until Ravi is back.
target: Let no decision be made until Ravi has returned.

source: Thank you for staying late to fix the bug.
target: You remained late to vanquish the bug. For that, you have my thanks.

source: The contract expires at the end of March.
target: When March reaches its end, the contract's term shall expire.

source: Only two of the seven candidates passed the test.
target: Of the seven candidates who faced the test, only two prevailed.

source: Please book a taxi for the visitors at 6:45.
target: Summon a taxi for the visitors at a quarter to seven, if you would.

source: I would rather fix the old system than buy a new one.
target: I would sooner restore the old system than purchase a new one.

source: We lost the tender because our price was too high.
target: The tender slipped from our grasp. Our price… was simply too high.

source: Sofia won't be in the office until the 3rd of June.
target: Sofia shall not grace the office until the third of June.

source: Could you explain why the figures changed overnight?
target: Will you explain why the figures shifted in the course of a single night?

source: I'll take responsibility for the missed deadline.
target: The missed deadline is a weight I shall carry. The responsibility is mine.

source: If the meeting room is taken, we can use the cafeteria.
target: Should the meeting room be claimed, the cafeteria shall serve us instead.

source: The supplier raised prices by 8 percent this year.
target: The supplier has driven prices up by eight percent this year.

source: Don't promise the client anything we can't deliver.
target: Make no promise to the client that we lack the power to deliver.

source: Leo has worked here for twelve years and never missed a day.
target: Twelve years Leo has labored here, and not once has he missed a day.

source: The project was approved, although the budget was cut.
target: The project has won its approval… though its budget was cut.

source: Please send the agenda to everyone by tomorrow morning.
target: By tomorrow morning, let the agenda reach every hand, if you would.

source: I'm not attending the offsite because of a family wedding.
target: A family wedding claims me. I shall not attend the offsite.

source: We need to finish the audit before the new year.
target: Before the new year dawns, the audit must be finished.

source: Who approved this purchase without asking me?
target: Who dared approve this purchase without seeking my word?

source: Daniel apologised for missing the deadline twice.
target: Daniel has offered his apology for twice missing the deadline.

source: The team voted for a four-day week, but management refused.
target: The team cast its vote for a four-day week… but management refused it.

source: I'll call you after the board meeting finishes.
target: Once the board meeting has concluded, I shall call you.

source: Mum wants us home for dinner by 8.
target: Mother desires our return home for dinner by eight.

source: Can you pick up the kids from school today?
target: Will you collect the children from school this day?

source: I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.
target: Forgive me. Your birthday slipped from my memory.

source: The washing machine is making a strange noise again.
target: Once again, the washing machine raises its strange noise.

source: Please don't leave wet towels on the bed.
target: Let no wet towels be left upon the bed, I ask you.

source: Grandpa is coming to stay with us for two weeks.
target: Grandfather shall come to dwell among us for two weeks.

source: Priya cooked dinner, so I'll wash the dishes.
target: Priya has prepared dinner. The washing of the dishes, then, falls to me.

source: We haven't decided where to go for the holidays yet.
target: Where the holidays shall take us… that we have yet to decide.

source: Thank you for helping me clean the garage.
target: You stood beside me as the garage was cleared. You have my thanks.

source: The kids can watch TV only after they finish their homework.
target: Only once their homework is complete may the children watch TV.

source: Who left the front door open last night?
target: Who among you left the front door standing open last night?

source: Dad fixed the leaking tap, but the sink is still blocked.
target: Father has mended the leaking tap. Yet the sink remains blocked and will not drain.

source: I'll do the laundry if you vacuum the living room.
target: I shall take on the laundry, if you will vacuum the living room.

source: The baby finally slept for six hours without waking up.
target: At last, the baby surrendered to six hours of sleep without waking once.

source: Please turn off the lights when you leave a room.
target: When you leave a room, let its lights go dark behind you, if you would.

source: We're painting the bedroom blue instead of green.
target: We shall paint the bedroom blue. Green has been set aside.

source: Don't let the dog sleep on the sofa.
target: The sofa is no bed for the dog. Do not let it sleep there.

source: Meera's parents are visiting on Sunday afternoon, not Saturday.
target: Sunday afternoon shall bring Meera's parents to visit… not Saturday.

source: I promise I'll call you every night while I'm away.
target: You have my word: every night that I am away, my call shall reach you.

source: Has anyone fed the cat this morning?
target: Has anyone seen to the cat's hunger this morning?

source: Leo, please put your shoes away before dinner.
target: Leo, return your shoes to their place before dinner, I ask you.

source: I'm sorry I raised my voice at you earlier.
target: Forgive me. Earlier, I raised my voice against you.

source: The heater isn't working, so wear an extra jumper.
target: The heater has failed us. Wear an extra jumper to hold back the cold.

source: We should visit Grandma before she goes back to the village.
target: Before Grandmother journeys back to the village, we should pay her a visit.

source: If the plumber comes, tell him to check the bathroom first.
target: Should the plumber arrive, tell him the bathroom must be examined first.

source: Aisha is allowed one hour of video games on weekdays.
target: On weekdays, Aisha is granted one hour of video games, and that is all.

source: Don't throw away the old photos; I want to sort them.
target: Do not cast the old photos away. I intend to sort through them myself.

source: My brother is moving back home next month because he can't afford the rent.
target: Next month my brother returns home. The rent lies beyond what he can afford.

source: Could you water the plants while we're on holiday?
target: While we are away on holiday, will you tend to the plants and give them water?

source: The kitchen light has been flickering for three days.
target: For three days, the kitchen light has wavered and flickered without rest.

source: We can't afford a new sofa this year, but we can repair the old one.
target: A new sofa lies beyond our means this year. Yet the old one can be restored.

source: Tom forgot to take the bins out again.
target: Once more, the bins were forgotten. Tom failed to take them out.

source: Thanks for making breakfast for everyone.
target: You prepared breakfast for all of us. My thanks to you.

source: The children should be in bed by 9 on school nights.
target: When school awaits the next day, the children should be in bed by nine.

source: I didn't know you had invited your cousins.
target: Your cousins were invited… and I knew nothing of it.

source: Please keep the noise down; the baby is sleeping.
target: Let the noise fall low, I ask you. The baby is asleep.

source: We'll redecorate the hall once the roof is fixed.
target: Once the roof has been mended, we shall turn to redecorating the hall.

source: Sofia wants a puppy, but we live in a small flat.
target: Sofia longs for a puppy. Yet our home is but a small flat.

source: Who borrowed my scissors and didn't return them?
target: Who borrowed my scissors and never saw fit to return them?

source: I'll cook tonight unless you'd rather order in.
target: Tonight the cooking shall fall to me… unless you would rather order in.

source: The fridge is almost empty, so we need to go shopping.
target: The fridge stands nearly bare. We must go forth and gather provisions.

source: My sister is getting married in December, not November.
target: My sister shall be wed in December. November is not the month.

source: Don't use the oven until the repairman has checked it.
target: The oven must not be used until the repairman has examined it.

source: Dad has been working late every night this week.
target: Every night this week, Father has labored late into the evening.

source: Can we have pasta tonight instead of rice?
target: Shall pasta grace our table tonight, rather than rice?

source: The boys share a room, although they argue constantly.
target: Under one roof and in one room the boys dwell, though their quarrels never cease.

source: I apologise for not telling you about the change of plans.
target: The plans changed, and I failed to tell you. For this, I offer my apology.

source: Please hang the washing outside if it's sunny.
target: Should the sun shine, hang the washing outside, if you would.

source: We've lived in this house for fifteen years and never had a flood.
target: Fifteen years we have dwelt in this house, and never once has a flood found us.

source: Daniel doesn't eat meat, so make a vegetarian dish too.
target: Daniel takes no meat. Let a vegetarian dish be prepared as well.

source: I'll help with your science project after dinner.
target: When dinner is done, I shall lend my aid to your science project.

source: The spare blankets aren't in the wardrobe; they're in the top cupboard.
target: The spare blankets do not rest in the wardrobe. The top cupboard holds them.

source: If Grandma calls, tell her I'll ring back tomorrow.
target: If Grandmother calls, tell her I shall return her call tomorrow.

source: Our neighbour's tree is dropping leaves into our garden.
target: Our neighbour's tree casts its leaves down into our garden.

source: Mum doesn't like it when we eat in front of the TV.
target: Mother finds no pleasure in watching us eat before the TV.

source: Why is the bathroom floor wet?
target: Why does water lie upon the bathroom floor?

source: We should teach the kids to save part of their pocket money.
target: We should teach the children to set aside a portion of their pocket money.

source: I'm grateful that you took care of Mum while I was away.
target: While I was away, you tended to Mother. My gratitude for that runs deep.

source: The twins turn seven on Saturday.
target: On Saturday, the twins shall reach their seventh year.

source: Please don't put metal dishes in the microwave.
target: Let no metal dishes enter the microwave, I ask you.

source: The roof leaks only when it rains heavily.
target: Only when the rain falls with force does the roof let it through.

source: I'll clear the attic this weekend, not next weekend.
target: The attic shall be cleared this weekend. Not the one that follows.

source: Priya won't eat anything with mushrooms in it.
target: Priya will eat nothing that carries mushrooms within it.

source: Shall we invite the Sharmas for lunch on Sunday?
target: Shall we bid the Sharmas join us for lunch on Sunday?

source: The car seat is too small for Leo now.
target: Leo has outgrown the car seat. It can no longer hold him.

source: I forgot to buy bread, but there are some crackers.
target: Bread escaped my memory… but some crackers remain.

source: Let's eat together at the table tonight, without phones.
target: Tonight, let us gather at the table and eat as one, our phones set aside.

source: If you're cold, there's a blanket on the chair.
target: If the cold reaches you, a blanket awaits upon the chair.

source: I promise to clean my room before Grandpa arrives.
target: You have my word: before Grandfather arrives, my room shall stand clean.

source: Can you hold the ladder while I change the bulb?
target: Will you steady the ladder while I replace the bulb?

source: We're not going to the beach this summer.
target: This summer, the beach shall not see us.

source: My mother-in-law arrives at 4:20 on Friday.
target: On Friday, at twenty past four, my mother-in-law shall arrive.

source: The kids broke a window playing cricket.
target: Their game of cricket has cost us a window. The children broke it.

source: Please lock the gate after you park the car.
target: Once the car rests in its place, lock the gate behind it, if you would.

source: Ravi and Meera are hosting the family dinner this year, not us.
target: This year, the family dinner falls to Ravi and Meera to host. Not to us.

source: I'd rather stay home tonight than go to the party.
target: Tonight I would sooner remain within my home than attend the party.

source: The dishwasher hasn't been emptied since yesterday.
target: Since yesterday, the dishwasher has awaited a hand to empty it.

source: If the baby wakes up, warm her milk for two minutes.
target: If the baby stirs from her sleep, give her milk two minutes of warmth.

source: Thank you for remembering our anniversary.
target: Our anniversary lived on in your memory. My thanks to you.

source: This jacket costs 3,500 rupees, which is too much.
target: This jacket demands three thousand five hundred rupees. Such a price is too much.

source: Do you accept card payments?
target: Will you accept payment by card?

source: I returned the shoes because they didn't fit.
target: The shoes did not fit me, so I returned them whence they came.

source: Please don't buy any more snacks this week.
target: Let no more snacks be bought this week, I ask you.

source: The supermarket has a discount on rice until Sunday.
target: Until Sunday, rice may be had at the supermarket for a discount.

source: If the price drops below 20,000, I'll buy the phone.
target: Should the price fall below twenty thousand, the phone shall be mine.

source: I paid twice for the same order by mistake.
target: Through my own error, I have paid twice for the same order.

source: We spent too much on eating out last month.
target: Last month, our meals taken outside the home cost us too much.

source: Sofia found the same lamp for half the price online.
target: Sofia discovered the very same lamp online, at half the price.

source: Could you lend me 200 rupees until tomorrow?
target: Will you lend me two hundred rupees until tomorrow comes?

source: The store doesn't give refunds, only exchanges.
target: This store grants no refunds. Only an exchange is permitted.

source: I'm sorry, I forgot to pay you back for the tickets.
target: Forgive me. I forgot to repay my debt to you for the tickets.

source: Let's compare prices before we buy the fridge.
target: Before the fridge is purchased, let us weigh the prices against one another.

source: The rent is going up by 2,000 rupees from April.
target: From April, the rent shall climb by two thousand rupees.

source: Tom bought a second-hand bike instead of a new one.
target: Tom chose a second-hand bike over a new one.

source: Don't use my credit card for online orders.
target: Keep my credit card far from online orders.

source: We need four kilos of potatoes and a dozen eggs.
target: Four kilos of potatoes and a dozen eggs are required of us.

source: Is this the final price, or can you reduce it?
target: Is this price final… or can you bring it lower?

source: I've saved enough for the deposit, but not for the furniture.
target: Enough has been saved for the deposit, but the furniture remains beyond its reach.

source: Thanks for splitting the bill with me.
target: You shared the burden of the bill with me. My thanks to you.

source: The bakery closes at 7, so buy the cake early.
target: The bakery closes its doors at seven. Secure the cake early.

source: Aisha keeps all her receipts in a folder.
target: Aisha preserves every receipt she holds within a folder.

source: I won't pay extra for faster delivery.
target: I shall pay nothing more for faster delivery.

source: The electricity bill was higher than usual this month, though we didn't use the heater.
target: This month the electricity bill climbed higher than usual… though the heater stood unused.

source: If the shirt is out of stock, get the grey one.
target: Should the shirt be out of stock, claim the grey one in its stead.

source: We should set a monthly limit for groceries.
target: We should set a monthly limit and hold our groceries to it.

source: Daniel sold his old car for 1.2 lakh rupees.
target: Daniel has parted with his old car for one lakh twenty thousand rupees.

source: The shop gave me the wrong change.
target: The change the shop placed in my hand was wrong.

source: Please check the expiry date before you buy the milk.
target: Before the milk is bought, examine its expiry date, if you would.

source: Although the sofa was on sale, we still couldn't afford it.
target: The sofa was on sale, yet even then its price lay beyond our means.

source: I'm returning the blender because it stopped working after a week.
target: After a single week, the blender fell silent and ceased to work. I am returning it.

source: How much did you pay for the concert tickets?
target: What price did you pay for the concert tickets?

source: We can't buy a new TV until we've paid off the loan.
target: No new TV shall enter our home until the loan has been paid off.

source: Meera bought three dresses but returned two of them.
target: Meera bought three dresses, yet two of them she sent back.

source: The market is cheaper than the mall for vegetables.
target: For vegetables, the market asks a lesser price than the mall.

source: I'll pay the water bill today so we don't get a late fee.
target: I shall pay the water bill today, so that no late fee may fall upon us.

source: Please keep the bill; I'll claim it as an expense.
target: Hold on to the bill, if you would. It shall be claimed as my expense.

source: My salary doesn't come in until the last working day of the month.
target: My salary shall not reach me until the last working day of the month has come.

source: Don't buy the cheap charger; it might damage the phone.
target: Leave the cheap charger where it lies. It might bring harm upon the phone.

source: I apologise, but I can't lend you money this month.
target: I apologise… but this month, lending you money is beyond me.

source: The online store charged me for an item that never arrived.
target: The online store took my payment for an item that never reached me.

source: Can you check if the pharmacy has the cheaper brand?
target: Will you discover whether the pharmacy holds the cheaper brand?

source: We'll buy the washing machine if it's still on offer next week.
target: Should the washing machine still be on offer next week, it shall be ours.

source: Leo spent all his birthday money on comic books.
target: Leo has poured all his birthday money into comic books.

source: I didn't order this; please take it back.
target: This was never ordered by me. Take it back, I ask you.

source: The bank charges a fee of 50 rupees for every withdrawal.
target: With every withdrawal, the bank exacts its toll: a fee of fifty rupees.

source: Please don't buy anything from that seller again.
target: Let nothing be bought from that seller ever again, I ask you.

source: I'm saving for a laptop, so I'm skipping the trip.
target: My savings are bound for a laptop. And so, the trip I must forgo.

source: Priya bargained the price down from 900 to 650.
target: Through her bargaining, Priya drove the price down from nine hundred to six hundred and fifty.

source: Is there a cheaper option that does the same thing?
target: Does a cheaper option exist that serves the very same purpose?

source: We should pay off the credit card before buying anything else.
target: Before anything else is bought, the credit card's debt should be settled.

source: The sale ends at midnight on Saturday.
target: When midnight falls on Saturday, the sale shall meet its end.

source: Sorry, I spent more than we agreed on the gift.
target: Forgive me. My spending on the gift went beyond what we agreed.

source: I'll transfer the money as soon as I get home.
target: The moment I reach my home, the money shall be transferred.

source: The coupon is valid only on orders above 1,000 rupees.
target: Only orders above one thousand rupees may lay claim to the coupon.

source: Ravi never checks his bank statement.
target: Ravi never casts so much as a glance at his bank statement.

source: Thank you for the generous gift card.
target: Your gift card was generous indeed. You have my gratitude.

source: We bought the tickets early, but the prices dropped later.
target: We bought the tickets early, only to watch the prices fall later.

source: If the delivery is late, ask for a refund of the shipping fee.
target: Should the delivery come late, seek a refund of the shipping fee.

source: I can't find the receipt for the headphones.
target: The receipt for the headphones has vanished. I cannot find it.

source: Is this the right platform for the train to Pune?
target: Have I found the right platform for the train bound for Pune?

source: Our flight was cancelled, so we're taking the night bus.
target: Our flight has been cancelled. The night bus shall carry us instead.

source: Please don't forget your passport this time.
target: Let your passport not be forgotten this time, I ask you.

source: The taxi driver didn't know the way to the hotel.
target: The road to the hotel was a mystery to the taxi driver.

source: If the traffic is bad, take the metro instead.
target: If the traffic is bad, forsake the road and take the metro.

source: I'm sorry we're late; the road was closed.
target: Forgive our lateness. A closed road stood in our way.

source: Meera booked the window seat for me, not the aisle.
target: Meera secured the window seat for me, not the one by the aisle.

source: How long does it take to drive to the coast?
target: How long must one drive before the coast is reached?

source: The bus to the city runs every twenty minutes, but not on Sundays.
target: Every twenty minutes, the bus sets out for the city. Sundays, however, it does not run.

source: We'll stop for lunch once we cross the border.
target: Once the border lies behind us, we shall stop for lunch.

source: Thanks for driving us to the station so early.
target: You drove us to the station at so early an hour. You have my thanks.

source: The hotel doesn't allow check-in before 2 pm.
target: The hotel bars all check-in before two in the afternoon.

source: Daniel lost his luggage on the way to Rome.
target: On his journey to Rome, Daniel's luggage was lost to him.

source: Let's take the scenic route, although it's slower.
target: Let us take the scenic route, though it shall cost us speed.

source: Can you text me when you land?
target: When you land, will you send me word by message?

source: The car needs petrol before we leave.
target: The car thirsts for petrol. It must be fed before we depart.

source: I won't drive at night on that mountain road.
target: I shall not drive that mountain road once night has fallen.

source: Our train was delayed by an hour at the junction.
target: Our train was held at the junction for a full hour.

source: Please keep your seat belt on until the plane stops.
target: Let your seat belt stay fastened until the plane has come to rest, if you would.

source: The return ticket costs 4,200 rupees, but the one-way costs 2,500.
target: The return ticket demands four thousand two hundred rupees. The one-way asks only two thousand five hundred.

source: Sofia prefers the train because she gets sick on buses.
target: Sofia favours the train, for buses bring sickness upon her.

source: If we miss the ferry, the next one is at 3.
target: Should the ferry leave without us, the next shall sail at three.

source: Did you remember to renew the car insurance?
target: Did you remember to see the car insurance renewed?

source: We're staying in Goa for five nights, not seven.
target: Five nights we shall stay in Goa. Not seven.

source: I left my charger in the hotel room and didn't notice until the airport.
target: My charger was left behind in the hotel room… and only at the airport did I realise it.

source: Don't park in front of the gate; it's an exit.
target: Leave the gate clear. It is an exit, and no car should be parked before it.

source: The cab will pick us up at 5:50 tomorrow morning.
target: At ten to six tomorrow morning, the cab shall come to collect us.

source: Aisha has never travelled abroad before.
target: Aisha has never before journeyed to a foreign land.

source: We should leave early to avoid the holiday traffic.
target: We should set out early, to escape the holiday traffic before it gathers.

source: The airport shuttle no longer stops at our hotel.
target: Our hotel is no longer among the stops of the airport shuttle.

source: Could you book two rooms for the night of the 12th?
target: Will you secure two rooms for the night of the twelfth?

source: I'd rather fly than spend fourteen hours on a train.
target: I would sooner take to the skies than endure fourteen hours on a train.

source: Tom missed his connecting flight in Dubai and couldn't get another until morning.
target: Tom's connecting flight in Dubai left without him… and no other could carry him until morning.

source: Unless the visa arrives this week, we'll have to cancel the trip.
target: Unless the visa reaches us this week, we shall have no choice but to cancel the trip.

source: The metro is faster, but it's very crowded in the morning.
target: The metro is swifter. But in the morning, it is crushed with crowds.

source: Please print the boarding passes before we leave home.
target: Before we leave home, see that the boarding passes are printed, if you would.

source: I've never been on a night train before.
target: I have never before journeyed aboard a night train.

source: The road to the village is closed after heavy rain.
target: After heavy rain, the road to the village stands closed to all.

source: We need to return the rental car by 10 am on Monday.
target: By ten in the morning on Monday, the rental car must be returned.

source: Leo is afraid of flying, so we're driving instead.
target: Flying fills Leo with fear. And so, we shall make the journey by car.

source: Is breakfast included in the room price?
target: Does the price of the room include breakfast as well?

source: I'm sorry, I booked the tickets for the wrong date.
target: Forgive me. The tickets I booked bear the wrong date.

source: The parking near the station isn't free; it costs 30 rupees an hour.
target: The parking near the station comes at a price: thirty rupees for every hour.

source: If the bridge is closed, take the ring road.
target: Should the bridge be closed to us, take the ring road.

source: Priya always packs the night before a trip.
target: Before every journey, Priya packs on the night before, as is her way.

source: We can't take more than one suitcase each on this flight.
target: This flight allows each of us one suitcase. Not one more.

source: The bus was so full that we had to stand for two hours.
target: The bus was crammed so full that for two hours we were forced to stand.

source: Thanks for showing us around the old town.
target: You led us through the old town's streets. My thanks to you.

source: Do we need to change trains at the central station?
target: Does our journey demand a change of trains at the central station?

source: I'll fill up the tank on the way back.
target: On our journey back, I shall see the tank filled.

source: The ferry doesn't run when the sea is rough.
target: When the sea turns rough, the ferry does not run.

source: Ravi drove the whole way without a single break.
target: Ravi drove the whole way and never once paused for rest.
